issue_request: FHIR-15827 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification and asked for Address and HumanName to use the same text-element clarification: text may be provided instead of or as well as structured parts, and applications updating the datatype SHALL ensure that when both are present the text does not include content absent from the parts.

additional_context: FHIR-12351 is background for why HumanName no longer had the older text/parts agreement sentence before FHIR-15827. The originating Zulip thread confirms the concern was inconsistent Address and HumanName wording. source/fhir.ini lists HumanName and Address as active datatypes and maps datatype pages through source/datatypes.html, and Confluence searches found no additional or conflicting meeting record.
